decide.port_notes: Original Codex skill and dependency-free Node helper based on the September 29, 2026 Ollama announcement. Preserves choice, noul, and score semantics. Version 0.2.0 adds vision image input (top-level `images`, base64) for the `clef` family such as `clef-flash`, matching Ollama's decision/types.go and decision/clef.go; videos remain unsupported. No generative-chat fallback or host extensions.
